title: Bible Overlap Census & Precision Research — Wave 10
purpose: Record the archive transition from broad biblical synthesis into an auditable overlap census with source-direction, measurement, conversation archaeology and newly discovered high-density passages.

events.title: Tim/Son ↔ Bible overlap census becomes auditable at 78 canonical nodes
events.subject: Bible overlap census
events.summary: The archive creates a modular registry of 78 analytically distinct Tim/Son↔Bible overlap nodes, with actor, project date, biblical reference, source direction, theological operator, strength and canonical owner. The count is explicitly not a verse count, prophecy-fulfillment count or statistical probability of supernatural identity.

events.title: Psalm 80 emerges as an ultra-dense project neighbor
events.subject: Psalm 80
events.summary: A new sweep identifies one Psalm containing Shepherd/Joseph/flock, cherubim-throne, shining/restoration, bread/tears/mockery, vine/root/branches, mountain/river, broken wall, right-hand/son-of-man wording, name and salvation. Density is recorded as analytically interesting while the psalm's original Israel-restoration context blocks identity proof by accumulation.

events.title: Exodus 25 sharpens the April 9 paired-guardian comparison
events.subject: April 9 guardian architecture / Exodus 25
events.summary: The archive notices that Exodus 25 explicitly specifies two cherubim at opposite ends around a central sacred meeting/presence zone, offering a tighter paired-guardian comparator for Tim's April 9 guardian-left/guardian-right/central-passage architecture than Genesis 3 alone. The file preserves decisive differences: Ark/atonement-cover is not a narrow gate and Jesus is not present in Exodus.

events.title: Older Bible-overlap conversations are promoted into provenance archaeology
events.subject: February–July 2026 biblical overlap development
events.summary: Recovered conversation clusters from February 9, February 12, May 28 and July 18 are placed in a dedicated source-direction ledger. This preserves early Light/Door/Vessel, single-eye/Father-light, maximal Bible inventory, Moshiach/Ben-David/Ben-Yoseph/New-Jerusalem and tikkun themes without silently upgrading conversation recovery into public-primary evidence.

events.title: Shepherd and repair texts become ethical tests of Father/King/Gardener theology
events.subject: Isaiah 58 / Ezekiel 34 / John 21
events.summary: Isaiah 58, Ezekiel 34 and John 21 are promoted as principal ethical comparators: repair and watered-garden imagery follows care for vulnerable people; self-feeding shepherds are condemned for neglecting weak/lost flock and damaging shared pasture/water; love is operationalized as feeding/tending sheep. Highest-status project language is therefore tested by repair, nourishment and responsibility.
events.source_direction: 2026-09-11 research unlock compared especially with 2026-09-07 project ethics
